lessons.title: Story Time: Moving Up to Key Stage 2
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to discuss a character's feelings about a big change.
success_criteria: I can say how the character felt about moving up.
I can find a clue that tells me.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss feelings about moving to Year 3 and Key Stage 2.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a story about a character moving up to a new, bigger school stage, modelling discussion of feelings.
lessons.independent_task: Children discuss and record how the character felt, and how they feel about Year 3.
resources_needed: Story book about starting a new school stage
key_questions: How did the character feel?
How do you feel about Year 3?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension and personal connection to the transition theme — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.plenary: Recap feelings about moving up to Key Stage 2.
lessons.home_link: Talk about how you feel about Year 3 with your family.

lessons.title: Number Recap: Counting and Place Value to 100
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate secure counting and place value understanding ready for Year 3.
success_criteria: I can count confidently to 100 and beyond.
I can represent numbers using tens and ones.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap counting and place value from across Year 2.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidate counting and place value skills, discussing what comes next in Year 3 (numbers to 1000).
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a counting and place value consolidation activity, extending informally towards 100+.
key_questions: How many tens and ones make this number?
Can you count confidently to 100?
lessons.assessment_notes: Final Year 2 number consolidation check, preparing for Year 3 — evidence for MATHS.N1.
lessons.plenary: Recap readiness for Year 3 number work.
lessons.home_link: Practise counting and place value together.

lessons.title: Writing a Letter to My Year 3 Self
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write a short letter with advice or hopes for Year 3.
success_criteria: I can write a sentence of advice or hope.
I can use varied sentence structures.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what advice they might give their future Year 3 self.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model writing a short letter with a piece of advice or a hope for Year 3, using varied sentence openers.
lessons.independent_task: Children write their own letter to their Year 3 self.
key_questions: What advice would you give?
What are you looking forward to?

differentiation.greater_depth: Write 5+ sentences with varied structures and detailed hopes/advice

lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective writing and sentence variety, an end-of-year writing skills check — evidence for ENG.W2/W3.
lessons.home_link: Read your letter to your family.

lessons.title: Addition and Subtraction: Final Consolidation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate secure addition and subtraction skills ready for Year 3.
success_criteria: I can add within 100 confidently.
I can subtract within 100 confidently.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap addition and subtraction strategies from across Year 2.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidate addition and subtraction skills, discussing progression to three-digit numbers in Year 3.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete an addition and subtraction consolidation activity.
key_questions: What strategy will you use?
Can you solve this without a number line?
lessons.assessment_notes: Final Year 2 addition/subtraction consolidation check — evidence for MATHS.N2.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate progress made in addition and subtraction this year.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising addition and subtraction over the summer.

lessons.title: Phonics and Spelling: Year 2 Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read words using the full range of Year 2 spelling patterns.
success_criteria: I can blend and read a range of words.
I can read a short passage fluently.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the full range of spelling patterns learned this year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidate reading using a mixed range of Year 2 spelling patterns and common exception words.
lessons.independent_task: Children read a short mixed passage, demonstrating fluency across the year's phonics/spelling learning.
key_questions: Can you read this word?
Can you read this passage fluently?

differentiation.support: Read with support, focusing on core patterns

lessons.assessment_notes: End of Year 2 phonics/spelling consolidation check, informing Year 3 planning — evidence for ENG.R1/W1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate the year's phonics and spelling progress.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading together over the summer.

lessons.title: Multiplication and Division: Final Consolidation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate secure recall of 2, 5 and 10 times tables ready for Year 3.
success_criteria: I can recall 2, 5 and 10 times table facts.
I can solve related division facts.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the 2, 5 and 10 times tables from last week.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidate times table recall and related division facts, discussing progression to 3, 4 and 8 times tables in Year 3.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a times tables and division consolidation activity.
key_questions: What is 7 x 5?
What is the related division fact?

differentiation.greater_depth: Recall all three times tables and related facts fluently

lessons.assessment_notes: Final Year 2 times tables consolidation check — evidence for MATHS.N3.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate progress in times tables this year.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising times tables over the summer.

lessons.title: Meeting Our Year 3 Teacher
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to prepare and ask a thoughtful question to their new teacher.
success_criteria: I can think of a thoughtful question.
I can ask it clearly and politely.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what children might want to know about Year 3 and Key Stage 2.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model preparing a clear, thoughtful question to ask a new teacher.
lessons.independent_task: Children prepare a question for their Year 3 teacher (real transition visit if scheduled, or role-play).
resources_needed: None required, or transition visit schedule
key_questions: What would you like to know about Year 3?
How will you ask your question clearly?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note spoken language and preparation for transition, more sophisticated than Year 1's version — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.home_link: Think of one more question about Year 3 with your family.

lessons.title: Fractions: Final Consolidation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate secure understanding of halves, quarters and thirds ready for Year 3.
success_criteria: I can find a half, quarter and third confidently.
I can explain my method.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidate finding halves, quarters and thirds of shapes and quantities, discussing progression to more fractions in Year 3.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a fractions consolidation activity.
key_questions: What is a third of this?
What is a quarter of this?

differentiation.greater_depth: Solve without concrete resources where possible

lessons.assessment_notes: Final Year 2 fractions consolidation check — evidence for MATHS.N4.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate progress made in fractions this year.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising fractions over the summer.

lessons.title: Reflecting on My Year 2 Reading Journey
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to reflect on their reading progress across Year 2.
success_criteria: I can say what I could read at the start of the year.
I can say what I can read now.
lessons.starter_activity: Look back at reading samples/records from earlier in the year if available.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss reflecting on reading progress made across the year.
lessons.independent_task: Children reflect on and record their reading progress this year.
resources_needed: Reading records/samples from the year if available
key_questions: What could you read at the start of the year?
What can you read now?

differentiation.greater_depth: Give detailed reflection on specific progress

lessons.assessment_notes: Note self-awareness of reading progress across Year 2, and readiness for KS2 reading demands — evidence for ENG.R1/R2.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate everyone's reading progress this year.
lessons.home_link: Read your favourite book from this year with your family.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Full Year 2 Consolidation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply the full range of maths skills learned across Year 2.
success_criteria: I can count, add, subtract, multiply, divide, measure and use money confidently.
I can explain my strategies.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap key vocabulary from the whole year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap of the year's core maths content across all areas.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a comprehensive mixed review covering the year's key maths skills.
key_questions: What strategy will you use?
Can you explain how you solved this?

differentiation.support: Complete with reduced complexity and support

lessons.assessment_notes: Final Year 2 maths consolidation summary for each child, informing Year 3 starting points and the end of Key Stage 1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate a whole year of maths learning, completing Key Stage 1 maths.
lessons.home_link: Review the year's maths learning together over the summer.
